_doc: COHERENCE-AGREE-3 (REVIEW-AGREE F9, 2026-11-12): the walker's second member — the private readers of the COURT and the GATE (the two facts the lane gave a home in the defence home's flag bag) and of a hired company named any other way than 'mercenary' (the names priorityHelpers.js listed before cure 9: hireling hall, free company, hired muscle, veteran's lodge; and 'sellsword'), outside src/domain/facts/, src/domain/defense/ and src/data/, counted by tests/lint/defenceFactReaders.walker.test.js. SHRINK-ONLY from its first commit: a row may only fall, and falls the commit its reader retires to the home; no row is ever added. Banked at the third seat's commit over 65ce74ce6. It does NOT see a defence word held in a constant (`const W = 'courthouse'; n.includes(W)`).
